sections.kicker: Prepared for RIBAS by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: RIBAS says it is not for everyone on the site and for everyone on Instagram.
sections.keep: Your boutiques, "where you will be met with our professional attention and knowledge." A physical world most online jewellers lack.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.quote: Desire to stand out begins with a choice. Not for everyone. Exactly as intended.
pins.what: The site speaks to the few.
pins.why: This is a clear stance, and it is the RIBAS that justifies fine jewellery prices.
pins.how: Keep it, and make everything else follow it.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: The stance gets lost under the rest of the page.

pins.quote: Fine jewellery for everyday and every occasion
pins.why: Everyday and every occasion is the opposite of not for everyone. That clash is what feels off.
pins.how: Pick one voice for both front doors.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: People meet two brands and trust neither fully.

pins.what: Most pieces are named by material only.
pins.why: Names make a piece desirable and memorable; materials make it a commodity.
pins.how: Name collections and pieces like the house that wrote "Not for everyone".
pins.label: Your products

sections.intro: You said something is off and you can't name it, and an agency did not fix it. I think it is a contradiction. Here is where it shows.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on RIBAS's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Hermès, from another category. It never says it is for every occasion.
